title: VCMI saved game metadata
description: Information on a saved game that can be read without loading mods used by the save

text.description: Text that can be displayed without texts of the map or campaign

translations.description: Text in every language provided by the map or campaign, language -> text

vcmiVersion.description: Version of VCMI that created the save, only for display to the player

saveTime.description: Time when the save was created, in seconds since Unix epoch

format.description: Format of the original map, value of EMapFormat

difficulty.description: Difficulty of the map as defined by its author

players.description: Number of players on the map

humanPlayers.description: Number of players on the map that can be controlled by a human

mapFile.description: Name of the map file, empty for random maps

humanPlayers.description: Number of players controlled by a human in this game

saveDirectory.description: Directory with autosaves of this game

day.description: Total number of days passed in the game

mods.description: Active mods that affect gameplay, root mod identifier -> mod

submods.description: Active submods that affect gameplay, as identifiers relative to the root mod
